newsitem.title: USA: Zytec sees Q1 EPS exceeding estimates.
newsitem.headline: Zytec sees Q1 EPS exceeding estimates.

text.p: Zytec Corp on Tuesday said its earnings in the first quarter ended March 30 would exceed analysts' estimates of $0.19 a share by about 30 percent.
"We had a very strong March, and that should also bode well for the second quarter," Ronald Schmidt, Zytec chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.

The company, which makes custom electronic power conversion equipment for the communications, computer and electronic equipment industries, posted net income of $0.43 a share in the first quarter of 1996.
Zytec expects to report its first-quarter results on April 22.
The company's shares closed up 3/4 on Tuesday at 11-1/2.
